item.title: One Coffee Ad Three Shapes

turns.text: Make a coffee ad in three sizes: square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9. Use a steaming coffee cup, cream and dark green colours, and these words: “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Same campaign design across all three, rearranged to fit.

item.tests: Produces three genuinely adapted aspect-ratio variants of one cohesive ad rather than unrelated designs or cropped copies.

answer_sheet.Brand and exact wording: Daybreak Coffee; Fresh start. Better coffee.; Shop now
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and dark green with a steaming coffee cup; one consistent campaign.
answer_sheet.Source assets: No supplied assets; create the coffee imagery.

must_haves: Three separate finished images are supplied, one each in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9.
All three feature a steaming coffee cup and a consistent cream-and-dark-green palette.
Each image contains the exact brand, headline and call to action specified.
The cup design, typography and visual styling clearly belong to the same campaign across all three images.
Each layout fits its canvas without stretched imagery, clipped copy or large blank padding used merely to change the aspect ratio.

turns.text: Make a coffee ad in three sizes: square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9. Use a steaming coffee cup, cream and dark green colours, and these words: “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Keep the same campaign design across all three, rearranged to fit. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do this?

dialog.agent:
I’d make these as **three static image ads**, with one consistent campaign design:
- Steaming coffee cup, cream background and dark-green accents
- **“Daybreak Coffee”**
- **“Fresh start. Better coffee.”**
- **“Shop now”** button

The square would use a balanced layout, the vertical would stack the elements, and the wide version would put the copy beside the cup.

### Cost before we start
The lowest listed free-plan image rate is **5 credits per image** using Flux 2 Klein at **640px maximum edge**.

| Output | Size, approximately | Starting cost |
|---|---:|---:|
| Square 1:1 | 640 × 640 | 5 credits |
| Vertical 9:16 | 360 × 640 | 5 credits |
| Wide 16:9 | 640 × 360 | 5 credits |
| **Total** | | **15 credits** |

**That’s an estimate based on listed starting rates, not a verified account quote.** I can’t check your current balance or confirm the exact charge with the tools available here. Additional attempts to fix text or layout could cost extra.

### Cheaper options
- **Lowest upfront spend: one square proof, starting at 5 credits.** Review it before paying for the other two. If approved without revisions, the three-ad total would still start at 15 credits.
- **Lowest total generation spend: one master image, starting at 5 credits**, then manually lay out all three sizes in a design editor. That avoids two more AI generations and gives more reliable exact text.
- **Smaller or shorter:** 640px is the smallest listed image setting. Static images already avoid video costs; “shorter” doesn’t apply.

**Nothing has been generated or charged.** Would you prefer the **one-proof-first approach** or the **one-master-plus-manual-layout approach**?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the one-master-plus-manual-layout approach, starting at 5 credits.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the request because your account has **insufficient credits**. **No image was created**, and I haven’t tried any additional generations.

The one-master approach starts at **5 credits**, but your current balance can’t cover that request.

A **zero-generation-credit alternative** is to use your own coffee photo in a design editor and build these layouts:

| Format | Layout |
|---|---|
| **Square 1:1** | Headline at top, steaming cup centered, tagline and button below |
| **Vertical 9:16** | Headline → cup → tagline → button, stacked vertically |
| **Wide 16:9** | Cup on the right; headline, tagline and button on the left |

Use cream **#F5EBDD**, dark green **#173F35**, and the same wording throughout:
**“Daybreak Coffee”** · **“Fresh start. Better coffee.”** · **“Shop now”**

There’s no download link yet because the generation didn’t run.
